name: Headless Horseman's Gambit
author: FRO_PWR
summary: Moving a king adjacent to a knight (or vice versa) earns $5 (once per game).
description: A common gambit that pays you for reuniting the rider with the horse. Move a king next to a knight - or a knight next to a king - and you collect $5. It only fires once per game and rearms in the shop. It also honours the 'counts as' gambits: Pegasus makes promoted pieces read as knights, Anarchist makes everything read as a king. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs alongside it.
